subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Babylonian Bottomry Loans
description: A quick, practical guide to Babylonian Bottomry Loans.

hook.text: Four thousand years ago, a merchant borrowed gold to fund a sea voyage. If his ship sank, he owed nothing.

buildup.text: Bottomry loans let lenders absorb shipwreck risk in exchange for a premium. Pay more now, survive disaster.

discovery.text: These contracts appear in the Code of Hammurabi, one of the oldest legal codes ever found.

twist.text: Pay extra now so ruin doesn't find you later. That logic is the seed of every insurance policy.

climax.text: Risk management wasn't born in boardrooms. It was born on ancient ships crossing open water.

quiz.question: What were Babylonian bottomry loans?
options: Loans forgiven if the ship was lost at sea
Loans with zero interest for priests
